name: timem-space
description: Cross-Agent Memory Management Platform — TiMEM Space, take your memories wherever you go. Provides cross-agent long-term memory over the MCP protocol: search_memories, create_memory, delete_memory and classify_memory_scene. Say "remember" once, and every Agent will remember you.

display.name: 记忆管理 · 太忆空间 TiMEM SPACE
display.description_zh: 跨 Agent 记忆管理平台——太忆空间，让你的记忆随你走。通过 MCP 标准协议为 AI 助手提供跨 Agent 的长期记忆：语义检索（search_memories）、记忆写入（create_memory）、记忆删除（delete_memory）与记忆场景分类（classify_memory_scene）。说一次「记住」，换多少个 Agent 都记得你。
display.description_en: Cross-Agent Memory Management Platform — TiMEM Space, take your memories wherever you go. Provides cross-agent long-term memory over the MCP protocol: search_memories, create_memory, delete_memory and classify_memory_scene. Say "remember" once, and every Agent will remember you.
